THE CAFETERIA · SCHOOL ROOM · AGES 2–5

Pear

Narrow at the stem, round at the bottom — a teardrop with a brown stem, the only silhouette on the shelf shaped quite that way.

The card’s activity

“Name the fruit” — printed on the pear card.

Do it now

Put the card on the table and run the activity twice — once slow, once with full lunchroom confidence. The card is the assignment; the rest of this page is bonus.

Keep going

The Pear has its own full lesson — what the food is, what the activity trains, the parent script and the questions to ask — plus a printable card page in the library.

PART OF THE CAFETERIA

Sixty-one more foods.

Pear is one of 62 foods on the Cafeteria shelf.
